Object Detection · `yolov13-n_640x640_pre-optimized` · DX-APP C++ example

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolov13_n_640x640_pre_optimized
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov13-n_640x640_pre-optimized_sync   # once
./bin/yolov13-n_640x640_pre-optimized_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov13-n_640x640_pre-optimized.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/yolov13/yolov13-n_640x640_pre-optimized/yolov13-n_640x640_pre-optimized_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov13-n_640x640_pre-optimized.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

|---|---:|
